title: Take partition_key threading — related[] with explicit limit (HEADLINE FIX)
description: Trigger shape for B3: parent table with related[] subquery that includes a child Take (limit). Without partition_key threading, child Take fetch (constraint-driven) and push (row-driven) emit different state keys. Hydrate uses fetch and works; push silently no-ops because states.get(push_key) returns None. Net effect: every related-with-limit silently mishandles child-table edits/adds/removes. Mutation: edit/add/remove a message inside the limited subquery — TS emits the change, RS does not.
wave1_action: After B3 fix lands (partition_key threaded through ast_to_operator_configs), re-run with mutation block updating a message body inside a related-with-limit subquery; assert TS and RS emit identical Edit transition.
